units.source_text: 端午日，源氏赴六条院东北的马场殿，乘便到西厅探视玉鬘，

en.t: On the day of the Boys' Festival, Genji went to the riding grounds in the northeast of Rokujo-in, and took the opportunity to visit Tamakazura in the west wing,
and said to her, "Well, how was it?

units.source_text: 那天亲王到夜深才回去么？

en.t: Did the prince stay until late that night before going home?

units.source_text: 对这个人不可过分亲近，因为他是有坏脾气的。

en.t: You must not become too intimate with that man, because he has a troublesome nature.

units.source_text: 世间男子，大多数会轻举妄动，使得对方伤心呢。”

en.t: Most men in this world act rashly and end up hurting the other person."

units.source_text: 他有时劝她亲近，有时又劝她疏远。

en.t: At times he urged her to draw closer, and at other times he urged her to keep her distance.
As he spoke, his expression was lively and elegant.

units.source_text: 他身穿一件金碧辉煌的袍子，上面随意不拘地罩着一件薄薄的常礼服，

en.t: He wore a splendid robe gleaming with gold and green, with a thin everyday court garment thrown casually over it,

units.source_text: 不知哪里来的一种清丽之相，使人不相信这是俗世人工染织出来的衣服。

en.t: and it had a pure, graceful beauty from some unknown source, making it hard to believe that the clothing had been dyed and woven by human hands in this ordinary world.

units.source_text: 他衣服上的纹样，与平时并无两样，

en.t: The patterns on his clothes were no different from usual,

units.source_text: 但今日看来特别新颖，飘来的衣香也格外芬芳。

en.t: but today they looked especially fresh, and the fragrance drifting from his robes was unusually sweet.

units.source_text: 玉鬘想道：如果没有那种恼人之事，这人的姿态多么可爱啊！

en.t: Tamakazura thought, if only not for that vexing matter, how charming this man would be in his bearing.

units.source_text: 正在此时，兵部卿亲王派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then, the Prince of Hyobukyo sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 这信写在白色薄纸上，笔迹楚楚可观。

en.t: The letter was written on thin white paper, and the handwriting was neat and pleasing to look at.

units.source_text: 看来很有意思，记录出来也并无何等特色：

en.t: It seemed quite tasteful at a glance, though there was nothing especially distinctive in recording it here:
